description: USDA weekly export sales report (FAS ESR) for a US farm commodity — corn, soybeans, wheat classes, sorghum, cotton, rice, soybean meal/oil, beef, pork and more: for one week of the marketing year, US totals and every destination's weekly exports, net new sales, outstanding sales, accumulated exports and total commitments, plus next-year sales; top buyers first. Units as reported (metric tons, running bales…). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

commodity.description: Commodity name or ESR code, e.g. corn, soybeans, all wheat, sorghum, all upland cotton, pork, 401

country.description: Optional destination filter, e.g. Mexico, Japan

marketYear.description: Marketing year as USDA numbers it (e.g. 2027 for corn Sep 2026-Aug 2027). Default: the current one

week.description: Week ending date YYYY-MM-DD (a Thursday). Default: the latest released week

title: Logistics Usda Ag Export Sales
